result_summary.title: Discrepancies in Analytics Dashboard data residency and consent records (ANZ Prod)
result_summary.description:
We are noticing inconsistencies in the production Analytics Dashboard for the ANZ region. Specifically, the data residency flags do not seem to match the user's location settings, and we are finding instances where consent records are missing from the dataset views.

We aren't sure if this is an issue with how the dashboard is rendering the data or if the underlying data itself is incomplete or mislabeled. It's affecting a small subset of users (3) with low business impact, but we need to understand the root cause before it scales.
